CHAPTER 01 · SIMULATION

The maze that remembers

Every square points to the next. Our traveler stops when the next step leaves the board or enters a square already seen.

1

First thought

“Just follow the arrows.”

The route is deterministic, so simulation is exactly the right instinct.

2

The trap

“Have I been here before?”

A list answers slowly. A visited matrix answers in constant time.

3

The invariant

Every move finds a new cell.

At most m × n moves means O(mn) time.

CHAPTER 02 · GRAPH ORIENTATION

The root with no incoming arrow

Trying every root repeats a full BFS. But the colors have already decided which way every edge must point.

COLOR LAW R → B → W → R
01

Orient once

Different endpoint colors allow exactly one direction that follows the cycle.

02

Count parents

The root has indegree 0. Every other node must have indegree 1.

03

Check binary

Only the root needs a degree check; non-roots spend one edge on their parent.
